notes: No qal attested for this root; piel ("strangle", active/transitive -- Nah.2.13, the lion strangling prey) is treated as the primary/citation stem rather than niphal's reflexive "strangle oneself" (2Sam.17.23, Ahithophel's suicide), matching the established pattern of preferring an active stem over a passive/reflexive one when both are available. DEFAULT_STEM_OVERRIDE added ("חנק": "piel") since niphal precedes piel in STEM_ORDER and would otherwise be picked by default.
